title: Courtesy Schedule for Late Billing of Non-Covered Items — Insulin Pump Program
content:
| Days from the denial's posting date to today | Late-billing courtesy |
|---|---|
| more than 90 (the late full days) | the charge is reduced by 20 percent (the late courtesy percent) |
| more than 45 (the late half days) but not more than 90 | the charge is reduced by 10 percent (half the late courtesy percent) |
| 45 or fewer | no late-billing courtesy |

**Scope.** This courtesy applies to a non-covered item charge on an Insulin Pump Program posted for the line a CO-151 claim denial bills. The days are counted in calendar days from the posting date of that denial to today.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Days elapsed | Courtesy |
|---|---|
| 45 | none |
| 46 | 10 percent |
| 90 | 10 percent |
| 91 | 20 percent |
